limitations: labels were written by the project author (same author as the checker)
datasets are small and about one frozen synthetic corpus
one 1.5B model, one prompt per result, one run each at temperature 0: single measurements
the digital twin and the customer feedback are constructed to be joinable
physical Safari and iPhone testing have not been performed
